title: Dean T NDE 46
content: On March 13, 1996 at three in the afternoon, I got very sick and knew I needed help. I called my brother and he came over immediately. He took me to the Stateline emergency room, where I had my first major heart attack. This part in the very beginning was really strange, I did not feel as though I was going to die. As I was being transported via ambulance to hospital, I remember stopping and being defibrillated twice, and then I was in emergency room of Barton hospital in South Lake Tahoe. I was admitted with ninety-nine percent closure of a vein from a blood clot. I was defibrillated in excess of twenty-eight times. I was watching everything from above the room. The only time I was in my body was after the defibrillator, so very painful for a moment or two, and then I would leave again. I heard all of the conversation in the room. I saw my dead relatives. After being released, I confirmed statements made by some of the personnel in the emergency room. They were amazed, to say the least. Some conversations I overheard about me were later asked to be forgotten due to the nature of the comments. After eleven hours I was so tired I wanted rest, so when they paralyzed me I slept for about what I thought was an hour, even though my eyes were taped I saw everything that was going on.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes I was having heart attacks. Before I was given the drug to paralyze me. The doctors had worked on me for eleven hours. During this process of installing a breathing tube, they cut my trachea causing aspirated pneumonia, and a temperature of 107.9. I left my body and watched as they placed bags of ice all over me. I was on a nitrogen blanket and they still had to pour ice on me to bring my temperature down. I watched the whole thing from above.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was not aware of my form; however the concern I felt for the person below was also very real.
elements.At what time during the experience were: As alert as I'm now, it was very real. I was on total life support for four days.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: The sounds I heard as I left were very loud, they filled my every thought.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I spent a great deal of time in the tunnel, each time I died I was sent to the tunnel. Several times, I was spoken to by the being of light. He was with my father, like he or she, I don't know which, seemed to have their arm around my father. Each time someone I knew would say, 'Dean, you're going back honey.' We would hear the defibrillator warm up and wham I was back in great pain as I slammed into my body after the shock.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw all my dead relatives. I was told the reason I had to come back was to get in touch with others like myself. The year 2000 is going to be very interesting. Be prepared, I'm afraid to tell what I know.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I could in no way with my limited abilities, describe it to you, I have never seen or felt anything like it. (See answers above too.)
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I knew so many people loved me and were praying that I would live, I felt a new love like I have never known.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew I was not going to die, no matter what. That was a great relief.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Everything happened as if it was real then, no life review, just explanation about what was happening to me. And why I had to come back.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future My life since March 13 has been a life I am proud of. I have spoken to so many people who have had a demon, somehow relating my experience to them helps them.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I had no choice, everyone knew I was coming back.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I had no choice, everyone knew I was coming back. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My love for life has never been as strong as it is now. I see people now totally different than before, I have compassion I never knew I had.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My love for life has never been as strong as it is now. I see people now totally different than before, I have compassion I never knew I had. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes This happened in 1996, since then, as each year passes, it is easier to talk about but for the first year I was a basket case. The emotions just jump out of me. The feeling I had when I met my departed father was the most beautiful thing I have ever felt. I got to know the love of my father something I had been denied since I was three.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes But I'm afraid to talk about it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Seriously there was no division. I say this is the most wonderful experience, one you have to die for.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Only with people that have needed me. They seem to gain some kind of peace within after talking to me.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Twice I had a dream about being defibrillated and found myself on the floor, knocked completely out of bed.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Not at this time, thank you from the bottom of my heart for allowing me to share.
